About this item

  • INNOVATIVE REEBOK TECHNOLOGY - Designed for everyday wear and responsive training, the Swiftstrike running shoes for men combine modern performance with iconic Reebok style. Available in men’s size 7-16 in medium, wide and extra wide widths.
  • LIGHTWEIGHT & COMFORTABLE - ​​A compression molded EVA midsole on these mens sneakers provides responsive cushioning for smooth, energized strides​. The open cell sockliner improves airflow, moisture management, and softness.
  • BREATHABLE MESH UPPER - An engineered mesh upper enhances breathability with a lightweight, supportive fit to keep your feet cool during intense workouts. The leather and synthetic overlays enhance durability and structure where it's needed most.
  • DURABLE RUBBER OUTSOLE - The athletic rubber outsole gives these mens running shoes superior traction on variable walking and running surfaces whether it's a trail, the gym, or the road. Reebok designs men shoes built to perform mile after mile.
  • MADE FOR EVERYDAY RUNS - These sneakers for men have lightweight materials that keep you moving comfortably during your daily sessions, while hot-melt quarter details add targeted structure and support.

Product Description

Push your limits and stay comfortable all day in the Reebok Swiftstrike mens running shoes. Built for everyday wear and light training, this versatile shoe features a breathable mesh upper with supportive leather and synthetic hot melt overlays that lock in the midfoot without adding extra weight. The compression-molded EVA midsole provides responsive cushioning for smooth, comfortable strides, while the durable rubber outsole covers high-impact areas for reliable traction with minimal added weight. With its sleek, lightweight design, the Swiftstrike delivers comfort, stability, and performance wherever your day takes you. Whether you're casually walking around town, jogging on the treadmill in the gym, or running long-distance miles on the street or track, these mens athletic shoes deliver dependable comfort and versatility. Ideal as everyday trainers or mens tennis shoes for active lifestyles, these mens sneakers help ensure you make it to the finish line. Available in grey, white with navy blue, and all white or black running shoes in mens shoes size 7-16 in medium, wide and extra wide widths.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these running shoes to be excellent quality, with good value for money and a nice appearance, particularly praising the amazing black color. The cushioning is well-received, with customers noting they feel very cushioned. The fit and sizing receive mixed feedback - while some find the xx-wide size perfect for wide feet, others say they run too narrow, and while some say the size is right, others mention they run small. The durability is also mixed, with some saying they hold up well while others report they rip within a month.

    A personal nit is how they were laced up when they arrived (not an open box or returned product). About this Item

  • INNOVATIVE REEBOK TECHNOLOGY - Designed for everyday wear and responsive training, the Swiftstrike running shoes for men combine modern performance with iconic Reebok style. Available in men’s size 7-16 in medium, wide and extra wide widths.
  • LIGHTWEIGHT & COMFORTABLE - ​​A compression molded EVA midsole on these mens sneakers provides responsive cushioning for smooth, energized strides​. The open cell sockliner improves airflow, moisture management, and softness.
  • BREATHABLE MESH UPPER - An engineered mesh upper enhances breathability with a lightweight, supportive fit to keep your feet cool during intense workouts. The leather and synthetic overlays enhance durability and structure where it's needed most.
  • DURABLE RUBBER OUTSOLE - The athletic rubber outsole gives these mens running shoes superior traction on variable walking and running surfaces whether it's a trail, the gym, or the road. Reebok designs men shoes built to perform mile after mile.
  • MADE FOR EVERYDAY RUNS - These sneakers for men have lightweight materials that keep you moving comfortably during your daily sessions, while hot-melt quarter details add targeted structure and support.

Product Description

Push your limits and stay comfortable all day in the Reebok Swiftstrike mens running shoes. Built for everyday wear and light training, this versatile shoe features a breathable mesh upper with supportive leather and synthetic hot melt overlays that lock in the midfoot without adding extra weight. The compression-molded EVA midsole provides responsive cushioning for smooth, comfortable strides, while the durable rubber outsole covers high-impact areas for reliable traction with minimal added weight. With its sleek, lightweight design, the Swiftstrike delivers comfort, stability, and performance wherever your day takes you. Whether you're casually walking around town, jogging on the treadmill in the gym, or running long-distance miles on the street or track, these mens athletic shoes deliver dependable comfort and versatility. Ideal as everyday trainers or mens tennis shoes for active lifestyles, these mens sneakers help ensure you make it to the finish line. Available in grey, white with navy blue, and all white or black running shoes in mens shoes size 7-16 in medium, wide and extra wide widths.
